ADITYA HRUDAYA
SENIOR PROCUREMENT & STRATEGIC SOURCING MANAGER
Mumbai, India • +91 78733 78177 • adityahrudaya74@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/Aditya-Hrudaya
EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Results-driven Senior Procurement & Strategic Sourcing Manager with 8+ years of enterprise experience directing 
end-to-end Source-to-Contract (S2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), complex commercial contract negotiations, Third-Party 
Risk Management (TPRM) and Vendor Risk Management (VRM). Proven expertise managing ₹492+ Cr ($59M+) in 
Direct and Indirect spend portfolios across Financial Services, Telecommunications, and Logistics. Adept at cross-
functional executive leadership, Zero-Based Budgeting (ZBB), Master Service Agreements (MSA), Contract Lifecycle 
Management (CLM), and advanced spend analytics in SAP MM, SAP Ariba, Coupa, and Tableau to achieve structural 
cost optimization and 100% internal audit compliance.
KEY CAREER HIGHLIGHTS & QUANTIFIABLE ACHIEVEMENTS
	 Spend Portfolio Management: Directed full lifecycle procurement across $59M+ (₹492+ Cr) in Direct and Indirect 
spend across IT, Telecommunications, Capex, Opex, and Logistic ecosystems with 100% audit compliance.
	 15% - 23% Structural Cost Optimization & Value Creation: Delivered up to 23% bottom-line savings on MHE logistics 
and 15% structural cost reduction across IT/Telecom spend using SAP Ariba RFx suite, market benchmarking, and 
Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) financial modeling.
	 Process Automation & P2P Efficiency: Accelerated purchase requisition-to-PO conversions by 20% by engineering 
Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workflow automation across SAP MM, Coupa, and integrated Tableau spend dashboards.
	 End-to-End Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) & MSA Negotiations: Drafted, negotiated, and executed high-
value complex Master Service Agreements (MSA), Statements of Work (SOW), and master rate cards, capturing 18% 
cost savings across nationwide branch expansions initiatives while maintaining 100% TPRM compliance.
	 25% Supplier Delivery & SLA Enhancement: Advanced Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) frameworks, 
boosting SLA delivery compliance by 25% and reducing order delays through structured KPI scorecards and active 
vendor management.
	 Risk Management & Audit Compliance: Executed zero-defect TPRM and ESG sourcing integrations in full alignment 
with Legal, IT, and Finance leaders achieving 100% audit compliance and a 98%+ on-time P2P cycle.

CORE COMPETENCIES & TECHNICAL SKILLS
	 Core Sourcing & Strategy: Strategic Sourcing, Source-to-Contract (S2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Category Management, 
Direct & Indirect Procurement, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), Zero-Based Budgeting (ZBB), Third-Party Risk 
Management (TPRM), Vendor Risk Management (VRM), ESG Sourcing, Order & PO Lifecycle Management
	 ERP & Procurement Platforms: SAP Materials Management (SAP MM), SAP Ariba, Coupa, Contract Lifecycle 
Management (CLM), Enterprise RFx (RFP / RFQ / RFI), VMS (Vendor Management Systems) tools, Reverse Auctions.
	 Contracting & Compliance: Master Service Agreements (MSA), Statements of Work (SOW), Business Requirement 
Documents (BRD), General Terms & Conditions (GTC), Commercial Contract Negotiation, Tail Spend Management, 
SLA & KPI Governance, Legal & Internal Audit Protocols
	 Spend Intelligence & BI: Tableau Spend Dashboards, Power BI, Advanced MS Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, Financial 
Modeling), Demand Forecasting, Cost Avoidance, MIS Reporting, Spend Analytics
	 Leadership & SRM: Supplier Relationship Management (SRM), Cross-Functional Leadership, Vendor Onboarding & 
Evaluation, Accounts Payable (AP) Reconciliation, Conflict Resolution.



PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Procurement & Strategic Sourcing Manager – IT & Non-IT Spend May 2024 – Present
L&T Finance | Mumbai, India
	 Direct end-to-end Strategic Sourcing and Category Management for INR ₹ 219 Cr /$26.3M USD in IT and Telecom 
Capex/Opex spend, managing a 3-member sourcing team and executing Enterprise RFx via SAP Ariba.
	 Engineered 15% overall cost reduction utilizing competitive Enterprise RFx tools (RFP / RFQ / RFI) in SAP Ariba, 
comprehensive market benchmarking, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis, and spend analysis.
	 Negotiated complex and high-value Master Service Agreements (MSA), Statements of Work (SOW), and rate cards, 
capturing 18% cost reductions across nationwide Loan Against Property (LAP) and Rural Business Finance (RBF) 
branch expansions.
	 Accelerated PR-to-PO conversion cycle time by 20% by streamlining Procure-to-Pay (P2P) requisition approval 
workflows and implementing automated spend MIS dashboards in Tableau.
	 Advanced Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) frameworks, boosting SLA delivery compliance by 25% via 
structured KPI scorecards, financial note audits, and No Dues Certificate (NDC) tracking across strategic suppliers.
	 Reduced site expansion Turnaround Time (TAT) by 15% across national locations through strategic vendor selection, 
contract standardization, and Opex budget alignment.
	 Spearheaded Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) and ESG Sourcing integration in coordination with Legal, Finance, 
and IT leaders, maintaining 100% adherence to Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) protocols.
	 Drove end-to-end Purchase Order (PO) tracking, delivery variance reconciliation, and order change-order processing; 
minimized fulfillment bottlenecks and order delays by 25% through real-time SAP Ariba tracking.

Assistant Manager – Indirect & Direct Procurement Feb 2021 – Apr 2024
Reliance Jio Infocomm Ltd | Navi Mumbai, India
	 Managed procurement purchases totaling INR ₹273 Crores / $32.8M USD leveraging hands-on spend analytics in SAP 
Materials Management (SAP MM), Coupa, demand forecasting, and competitive benchmarking.
	 Executed end-to-end Enterprise RFx cycles, commercial contract negotiations, and drafted legally binding MSAs, 
SOWs, BRDs, and GTCs with zero internal audit non-compliance.
	 Engineered a 23% reduction in per-pallet logistics costs and 12% fuel savings by structuring multi-tier MHE rental 
agreements (annual, quarterly, and on-call). Negotiated rate cards and preventive maintenance SLAs that ensured 
100% operational uptime across Fulfillment Centers (FCs), Distribution Centers (DCs), and Warehouses.
	 Consolidated end-to-end sourcing for 3PL manpower, on-call contingent labor, specialized staffing, and 3PL turnkey 
service contracts across Fulfillment Centers (FCs), Warehouses, and regional distribution networks, negotiating 
structured rate cards and SLAs.
	 Orchestrated nationwide strategic sourcing for direct operational assets (MHE machinery, FTTX infrastructure) as well 
as indirect services, manpower, and operational consumables supporting Fulfillment Centers (FCs) and Smart Hubs.
	 Conducted periodic vendor database audits across Fulfillment Centers (FCs), Distribution Centers (DCs), Warehouses, 
and Common Maintenance Points (CMP), maintaining zero breach of SLA and internal audit protocols.
	 Partnered with Finance and Accounts Payable (AP) to resolve complex GST, Invoice Receipt (IR), and defective invoice 
disputes, eliminating audit bottlenecks and maintaining a 98%+ on-time payment rate.
	 Accelerated emergency sourcing P2P lead times by 20% through streamlined PR-to-PO workflows in SAP MM and 
Coupa, guaranteeing uninterrupted material supply across nationwide fulfillment centers.
	 Steered Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) initiatives, establishing Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and 
supplier scorecards to drive continuous performance improvements, maintaining 100% SLA adherence and TPRM 
compliance.



Senior Associate – Sourcing & Procurement Jan 2019 – Jun 2020
IndiaMART InterMESH Ltd | Bangalore, India
	 Standardized complete Source-to-Contract (S2C) lifecycles, evaluating and qualifying strategic vendors based on 
financial turnover, compliance standards, and Turnaround Time (TAT).
	 Streamlined cross-functional vendor onboarding and invoice processing across 50+ supplier accounts, reducing 
payment cycle delays by 15% and maintaining 100% compliance.
	 Facilitated vendor negotiation meetings and benchmarked supplier pricing against industry standards to ensure 
competitive commercial terms.

Relationship Associate – Vendor Operations Apr 2018 – Dec 2018
Asian Paints Ezycolour Home Solutions | Bangalore, India
	 Administered work order execution and field contract governance to guarantee timely project execution, quality 
assurance, and site delivery.
	 Reconciled contractor material consumption reports against initial Bill of Quantities (BOQ) estimates to flag 
discrepancies and cost variances.
	 Managed financial processing across vendor bills, dealer settlements, and payment clearances, maintaining accurate 
project MIS records and seamless audit compliance.

EDUCATION & CREDENTIALS
Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) – Supply Chain & Finance 2016 – 2018
Acharya Bangalore B-School (AICTE Approved), Bangalore • Specialization: Strategic Sourcing, Financial Analysis, SCM, Costing & 
Budgeting
Bachelor of Commerce (B. Com) – Commerce Management 2013 – 2016
Ravenshaw University, Cuttack • Specialization: Accounting, Business Statistics, Costing & Commerce Management
CERTIFICATIONS & PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
	 Project & Process Excellence: Google Project Management Professional Certificate | Agile Project Management | Six 
Sigma Advanced (DMAIC)
	 Spend Analytics & SCM: Advanced Spend Analytics & Tableau Dashboards for SCM | Supply Chain Analytical 
Essentials | Business Intelligence
	 Strategic Sourcing & AI: Strategic Procurement & Contract Lifecycle Governance | Supply Chain Excellence | AI in 
Operations & Procurement
